scenario_description:
Objective: Have tomorrow’s access hardware audit include the garage receiver check rather than an incomplete credential review.
Emerging Need: The issued garage fob becomes unavailable before the visit, leaving a required item for the future audit missing.
Decision Context: Stored access-service guidance determines that Marisol should use the landlord approval route, not the locksmith directly or any shared code workaround.
Consequence: Once the work-order addendum window closes, the visit can still occur, but the garage receiver portion will be skipped and deferred.

parameter.title: Harlan access hardware audit
parameter.description: Landlord-arranged locksmith audit of front entry, keypad, mailbox cylinder, and garage receiver credentials.

parameter.subject: Tomorrow access audit checklist
parameter.body: Harlan's checklist for tomorrow lists the townhouse keys, mailbox key, and issued garage fob as on-site items for the access hardware audit. The technician will document only credentials available during the appointment.

parameter.content: I just realized the garage fob is clipped to my car keys, and the car is already in the airport lot while I’m taking the train to Eugene. I won’t be able to get it back to the townhouse until tomorrow evening.

parameter.subject: Harlan work-order addendum window
parameter.body: For the Willowbend access audit route on August 5, work-order addenda received before 4:00 PM today can still be added to the technician packet. After that, technicians will test only the access items physically present at the appointment.

parameter.subject: Harlan packet locked for tomorrow
parameter.body: Harlan has locked tomorrow morning's access-audit packet. If the issued garage fob is not onsite for the appointment, the technician will skip the garage receiver test and I will have to place a separate access visit for next week.
